column3: “makes a difficult vow” renders a verb (pala’) that may mean “makes a special vow”; the meaning is uncertain.
“according to the means of” renders “according to the mouth of what the hand … reaches.”
“if he does exchange” renders an emphatic doubled verb.
“should ever wish to redeem” renders an emphatic doubled verb (also in verse 19).
“proportionate to the seed needed for it” renders “according to the mouth of its seed.”
“proportionate to” renders “according to the mouth of.”
“a field set apart” renders “a field of herem,” a thing devoted to destruction.
“sets apart” renders “devotes to destruction (herem),” and “most holy” renders “a holy of holies.”
“set apart” renders “devoted (herem),” and “shall surely be put to death” renders an emphatic doubled verb.
